thread:
emily-r: Quick sync — v2 rollout to prod is showing a spike in mobile 500s from the last canary wave. Metrics: mobile error rate +1.8% vs baseline. Thinking we should pin clients back to v1 for 48h while we triage. Thoughts?

sean-backend: I saw the errors too. Stack traces point to tokenizer mismatch on long system prompts, reproduces on Android only so far. Not sure if it's a runtime quantization path.

maya-mobile: Confirmed on Pixel 6 internal build. Crash happens after long messages (~>1200 tokens) when using the new streaming endpoint. I can ship a quick SDK rollback flag but need coordination on server pin.

josh-f: Frontend is fine to respect a pin header if we expose it in the gateway. We already have `X-Redwood-Api-Version: v1` support in JS SDK. Maya, can you accept that header from mobile?

maya-mobile: Yep, we can. I can cut a mobile patch to set the header for beta users and an automatic fallback for all clients. ETA 2h for beta, 6h for wide rollout.

li-product: We should communicate to affected customers before a full client-side pin. Can we limit to mobile SDK versions < 3.1? That's likely the ones with the old tokenizer.

sean-backend: Good call. We can add a routing rule: if `User-Agent` contains `redwood-mobile/<3.1` then route to v1. Otherwise leave v2. That avoids a global pin.

deploy-bot: deploy started: gateway/routing-rule-update @ 1943216900 by emily-r — canary 10% -> 100% over 15m. See: https://deploys.internal/redwood/6789 :rocket:

emily-r: Rolling the rule to 100% now. If this holds we'll avoid a full rollback. Oncall, can you watch latency/error dashboard for next 30m?

oncall-sre: Watching and alert thresholds set: mobile-5xx > 0.5% or latency p95 +150ms triggers paging. Will notify immediately.

deploy-bot: deploy success: gateway/routing-rule-update @ 1943217030 — 100% applied.

maya-mobile: Beta patch pushed to 120 users with `X-Redwood-Api-Version: v1`. Early signals show crashes gone for beta devices.

josh-f: Can we add a metric tag to requests that are pinned so we can track split traffic? `header.pinned_version` = v1/v2. Helps for audits + billing.

sean-backend: Done. Added `pinned_version` tag in tracing and metrics. Will appear in dashboards in ~5m.

li-product: I'll draft a short customer note: what's affected, short mitigation, ETA for full fix. Sharing a link in #announcements.

emily-r: Plan going forward: 1) Keep targeted pin for <3.1 clients for 48h. 2) SRE + backend to triage tokenizer mismatch and push a v2 patch. 3) Mobile to widen patch if beta looks good. 4) Product comms on status + release notes update. If errors rise above threshold we'll rollback v2 globally — rollback checklist is in the playbook.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. If anything exceeds thresholds I'll escalate to oncall lead.

maya-mobile: Will start extended repro matrix and upload logs to the incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/v2-tokenizer/1943216789.

sean-backend: Assigning a short task: `fix/tokenizer-compat` branch created. I'll link a PR once I have a minimal repro fix.

emily-r: Thanks all. I'll close the loop once product note is live and we confirm stable metrics after 2h. :thumbsup:

li-product: Draft posted: https://docs.internal.redwood/release-notes/v2-compatibility-1943216789 — feedback welcome.

josh-f: Nice, added a note about SDK versions and the header.

deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled rollback window 1943300000 (12h) if no resolution.

emily-r: End of thread — monitoring continues.
